digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and destructive-repair pause mechanism
propositions: The bridge runner must execute identically across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single packaged entrypoint (rebar bridge run) without requiring repository-local runner scripts.
Legacy reconcile callers and checked-out workflows invoking rebar reconcile --mode must retain their behavior, published defaults, and exit codes without breaking.
Destructive-repair pause ownership must be provider-neutral, reading existing pause state, calling set_pause, and clearing via CAS using refs/reconciler/gate without GitHub CLI dependency.
The test suite must prove no GitHub CLI invocations occur during destructive-repair execution by rejecting any subprocess argv beginning with gh while running repair successfully.
Provider-neutral CI wrappers for GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab must remain thin configuration layers that delegate execution to the packaged Python core in _bridge_runner.py.
